figure_layouts.01_main_metrics_k_sweep: 2x2; top: LLA-3, LLA-5; bottom: LLA-9, LFR(TGN+FS); single column: 3.5 inches wide, 8 pt ticks/legend, 9 pt axis labels
figure_layouts.02_k8_distributions: 2x3; top: LLA 3/5/9; bottom: LFR(TGN+FS), ARI, Cosine-Silhouette
figure_layouts.03_paired_k_sweep: 2x3; top: LLA 3/5/9; bottom: LFR(TGN+FS), ARI, Cosine-Silhouette; each panel shows M11-B0, M11-B1, M11-M00, A1-A0, M11-A1

definitions.LLA: adjusted_lla_3/5/9; occupancy-corrected; three separate windows; higher is better
definitions.LFR(TGN+FS): lfr_both; TGN and Fractional Shift; figures and CSV
definitions.LFR(FS): lfr_shift; Fractional Shift only; CSV only
definitions.LFR averaging: saved five-perturbation mean; lower is better; contrasts retain condition-reference
definitions.ARI: three repeat-pair mean within sample, then sample macro; no repeat SD
definitions.paired ARI: condition-reference difference of each sample's three-pair mean, then macro mean and sample SD over samples defined in both conditions; no repeat SD
definitions.Cluster Occupancy: clean test only; per-sample counts/fractions and per-fold distributions; cluster IDs are not pooled across folds/repeats; single_cluster mean is a fraction
definitions.averaging: equal sample weights; common samples across all three repeats and compared conditions; sample SD and repeat SD have ddof=1; neither is a confidence interval
definitions.missing: undefined remains blank in CSV; reasons and availability retained; no zero imputation
definitions.interaction: derived from saved adjusted LLA and all three LFR variants per-sample/repeat scores; intersection of all four conditions and all three repeats
definitions.curves: solid=macro mean, dashed/dotted/dash-dot=repeat 1/2/3; gaps=undefined; common sample membership may differ with K; see CSV
definitions.k8_dots: each dot is a common sample's repeat mean (ARI: three-pair mean); black bar=macro mean; n=defined/common sample count
definitions.y_axes: LLA windows share limits within each figure, including all points/repeat curves; main/distribution ticks=0.1 for all panels; paired LLA keeps the first panel's original tick interval; different metrics keep independent ranges

source_verification: hashes of consumed snapshot and source metadata, manifest and coverage; does not rerun the full OOF check, spectra, maps, training, or inference
